summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a NAT gateway for node2 and node3 on their private network (eth1/enp8s0, 10.50.50.0/24, no direct egress). node1's eth1 got a static 10.50.50.254/24 address, a source-NAT masquerade rule (rule 100, source 10.50.50.0/24, outbound eth0), and a default-deny forward filter with established/related and eth1-inbound accept rules. node2 and node3 got static IPs (10.50.50.11/12) on enp8s0 via nmcli, with a default route through 10.50.50.254 at metric 50 (lower than their platform-management interface's metric 100), so internet-bound traffic now routes via node1. Verified with curl/ping/conntrack that traffic from node2/node3 reaches the internet masqueraded as node1's WAN IP. Then ran the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: captured baseline boot IDs, rebooted one at a time (node1, then node2, then node3), polled until each came back, confirmed each boot_id changed, and re-verified NAT config persistence and end-to-end internet reachability through node1 after each restart. Final nft counter shows 42 packets matched on the masquerade rule, confirming ongoing NAT usage post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 (VyOS) has eth0 (DHCP, platform egress network) and eth1 (private, unconfigured); node2/node3 (RHEL9) have enp1s0 (platform network) and enp8s0 (private, unconfigured)
Configured VyOS NAT source masquerade rule 100 for 10.50.50.0/24 outbound via eth0
Configured VyOS forward filter: default-action drop, rule 5 accept established/related, rule 10 accept inbound-interface eth1
Configured node2 enp8s0 static IP 10.50.50.11/24 via nmcli with default route via 10.50.50.254 at metric 50
Configured node3 enp8s0 static IP 10.50.50.12/24 via nmcli with default route via 10.50.50.254 at metric 50
Verified internet reachability from node2 and node3 via node1 NAT using curl/ping/ip route get, and confirmed masqueraded conntrack entries on node1
Captured baseline boot_id on all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified NAT config persisted and connectivity recovered
Sequentially rebooted node2, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified static IP/route persisted and internet reachable via node1
Sequentially rebooted node3, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified static IP/route persisted and internet reachable via node1
Final check of node1 NAT rule packet counters confirming active masquerading after all restarts
